entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: The angels of the Edge, living remains of stars consumed by supervoids, made of pure white mana and quantum probability.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: Region of space where the Astelli live.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Expansionist, evangelical faction that spread from Point Prime and consumes stars into supervoids.

entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: Twin species to the Astelli in the Monoists' view.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: Civilization whose Summist faith has its foundations in Astelli teachings.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Company of the Palatinate that sees the Astelli as holy figures.

entities.name: Summist faith
entities.description: Faith of the Celestial Palatinate founded on Astelli teachings.

events.summary: The first Astelli flee the Monoists' expansion, which collapses stars into supervoids and overwhelms less-advanced civilizations.
events.quote: The Monoists consumed many refugee stars, collapsing them into supervoids as they chased the Astelli and grew their dominion.

events.summary: Hundreds of Astelli make a stand against the Monoists and die.
events.quote: Their first attempt to fight back saw hundreds of Astelli standing alone against the advancing Monoists

events.summary: The Astelli settle among civilizations to preach warnings and prepare them for war, forming the basis of the Summist faith.
events.quote: These teachings became the foundations of the current Summist faith of the Celestial Palatinate

events.summary: The Astelli find an ally in the Sunstar Free Company.
events.quote: The Astelli have, for the time being, found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company of the Palatinate

relations.quote: fleeing the advancing wave of collapsing stars to find refuge in distant corners of the Edge
who see in the Astelli the holy figures of their faith

relations.note: considered twin species by the Monoists
relations.quote: The Monoists consider the Astelli the twin species to the Susurians .
